design: Inspect last prefill row and the decode row immediately before the first known token disagreement. Same experimental long-context binary source and previously verified weights, BF16/256-row/32K, page on GPU6 and fixed tile on GPU7. Keep response and full prompt IDs equal to each arm's prior uninstrumented output. Collect layer vectors and logits, not timed measurements. Reference BF16 Transformers SDPA on the same actual prompt and shared token prefix using prefill followed by single-token cached forwards. Compare per-head attention output and per-layer residual, report first exact difference separately from material error; no causal attribution to a particular kernel from correlation.
measurements: For each captured vector compare raw BF16 and relative L2 difference with HF. Report first layer for which relative L2 >=0.01 and >=0.10, and receipt of native first-choice logit. If a discrepancy already occurs in first-layer attention under equal native embedding, input norm and RoPE query, independently replay first-layer causal attention with captured Q and per-position KV if available before proposing a numerical fix.
